coverage_selection: maximum true quality on source validation only
notes: Evaluator cost is a sensitivity parameter in the same TFLOPs units as action costs; it is charged only to probed prompts.
Unprobed prompts use prompt predictions and original action costs; probed prompts use matched-image predictions and cascade costs.
Gate coverage and margin threshold are selected/frozen on validation; test labels never select the gate or routing policy.
Test routing multipliers/mixes use test predictions and row-specific costs only, matching the label-free deploy calibration of §25.
